title: Electrical stimulation of temporal and limbic circuitry produces distinct responses in human ventral temporal cortex
description: Intracranial EEG recordings from five patients undergoing single pulse electrical stimulation at the Mayo Clinic. The dataset supports identification of basis profile curves in human ventral temporal cortex and the study of how stimulation of temporal and limbic circuitry produces distinct cortical responses. Analysis code in Matlab is available from the authors.
methods_description: Patients rested in a hospital bed while single pulse electrical stimulation was delivered at about 0.2 Hz. Pulses were biphasic, 200 microseconds in duration, with an amplitude of 6 mA. Recordings were intracranial EEG.
